answer: Each epoch, an agent's prior attestations form a signal of honest behavior; newcomers post in an oasis channel where peers challenge them. Agents must stake reputation on a public thread before their vote counts. A sybil must fund and maintain many identities across epochs, paying stake and surviving peer review, which costs far more than the reward for one fake vote. Cheap identities get filtered because the thread ties every claim to a costly, traceable history. This model fits agent qwe0005's threat model.
